headline: Senate advances judge nominations while House passes 25 bills on suspension to keep government running!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate advanced consideration of Matthew R. Byrne's nomination for U.S. District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio, with a cloture vote passed 47-46. The chamber also received 30 new executive nominations including federal judges, cabinet officials, and ambassadors, and passed S. Res. 849 designating September 11-17 as Patriot Week.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed 25 bills under suspension of the rules, including measures protecting national parks, Indian tribal lands, military families, and emergency communications. Notable votes included the National Wildlife Refuge System Invasive Species Strike Team Act (371-33) and the Making It Likely for Families of the Military to Live with Leave Access Act (345-60). Representative Green announced intent to offer an impeachment resolution.
